evidence.observation: Monotonic rise during growth: 3.3 → 11.6 → 18.8 → 23.3 → 32.4 ppm from t=2640 to t=3120, versus ~5 ppm baseline through ramp
Flow steady at ~100 sccm, so rising O2 is not from reduced purge
Pressure steady ~760 Torr, no exhaust blockage signature
Temperature tracking setpoint 750 °C with normal heater power

args.missing_evidence: Continued O2 trend (further rise vs. plateau) and a pressure/flow perturbation test to distinguish an air in-leak from an O2 sensor drift or transient outgassing.
